title: SB209 (135th Legislature (2023-2024)): Regards lost or stolen firearms

operative_text:
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.20): Recklessly fail to report to law enforcement authorities forthwith the loss or theft of any firearm or dangerous ordnance in the person's possession or under the person's control.
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.20): A violation of division (A)(7) of this section is a misdemeanor of the first degree.
